audits.text:
## 5003370f0e31

**Reproduced lawful-degenerate overlap and ignored exact controls; source left
unchanged.** Audited generator SHA-256:
`5dac6411797ea7f21d47e08a56a92034386eb57ff3fa5b77a71f69f8070fdc63`;
selected rule hash: `38c225868bf6`.

The advertised `texture="all_full"` branch returns an `11×11` board with every
panel already full. `self_check` returns no findings, and the selected Racket
output is exactly the input. Thus identity, fill-all, and maximum-count selection
are indistinguishable in an input the module itself labels degenerate but its
validator accepts.

A second exact probe requested all declared controls, including
`grid_size=17` and `cell_size=2`. The generator returned an `8×8` grid and
`self_check` again returned no findings; the advertised `grid_size` control was
silently ignored. Unknown override names are also accepted, and no
`observe_overrides` contract exists.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/5003370f0e31/reproducer/input.json` — `all_full` input.
- `checks/audit/5003370f0e31/reproducer/racket.json` — Racket receipt proving
  output equals input.
- `checks/audit/5003370f0e31/reproducer/probe.json` — validator result and exact
  override request/returned shape.
- `checks/audit/5003370f0e31/reproducer/override-grid.json` — returned `8×8`
  grid.
- `checks/audit/5003370f0e31/battery/checks/5003370f0e31_after_battery_summary.json`
  — source-bound battery: 5 failed stages (`lint`, `defect_lint`,
  `profile_floor`, `semantic_gate`, `override`). The defect lint independently
  flags `all_full` as passing `self_check`; hard has zero exact canonical-profile
  support; no rule pin or semantic contract is declared.

A repair should remove degenerate textures from the ordinary control domain (or
make their lawful status explicit), reject unknown/ignored controls, and require
count variation plus at least one changed max panel and one cleared non-max panel
when the sample is intended to teach the rule. No audit-target files were
modified.

triage.reason: Both assigned source-bound findings read and retained with their actual reproductions. Explicit audit status set separately; acceptance retains findings and does not close them. Canonical/generated-domain, native lesson and out-of-domain validator scopes preserved; no audited target edited.
